result.summary:
REQ-025 (scheduled job runner and the idempotent send-once notification ledger, GitHub issue #28) had RELEASE-VALIDATOR PASS at Step 5, first requirement of Phase 5. Verified the factual claims directly against the real code before writing the status-history note, not from this handoff's summary alone: read apps/bot/drizzle/0005_violet_venom.sql (notification_ledger table with registration_id FK to registrations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT, kind text, and a real UNIQUE index uq_notification_ledger_registration_kind on (registration_id, kind) -- no in-memory Set/Map backs it); read apps/bot/src/domain/notification.ts's sendLedgeredNotification() line-by-line and confirmed the exact ordering: steps 1-3 resolve the user and check blocked/broadcast_opt_in with no ledger write, step 4 performs the single INSERT into notification_ledger and only AFTER that insert succeeds does step 5 attempt the Telegram send -- a duplicate-key violation (Postgres 23505, detected via pgErrorCode()'s unwrap through DrizzleQueryError's .cause) returns skipped-already-sent with no send attempted. Confirmed the accepted risk precisely: a crash after the insert commits but before the send completes leaves the ledger reading 'sent' permanently with no message actually delivered -- at-most-once, never over-delivery, which matches PRD 12.8's actual invariant (no duplicates, occasional under-delivery accepted). Confirmed SendClassification has no default value on SendNotificationInput.classification (TypeScript-enforced explicit choice at every call site, AC5) and that the blocked check runs unconditionally before the classification branch. Read apps/bot/src/scheduler/rateLimiter.ts (RollingWindowPacer's rolling 1s/25msg window, sendWithRetry's 429-only retry with retry_after-or-exponential-backoff up to 5 attempts, non-429 errors propagate immediately) and apps/bot/src/scheduler/runner.ts (first scheduled-job infra in this codebase: one setInterval per job, immediate first run for restart catch-up, per-job overlap guard that skips not queues, failure isolation via catch/finally). Read apps/bot/src/handlers/withdraw.ts's sendPromotionNotification() and confirmed it now calls sendLedgeredNotification() with kind='waitlist_promotion', classification='transactional', replacing REQ-023's prior in-transaction send-marker as the requirement's description required.

Actions taken:
1. Flipped docs/agents/requirements.yaml's REQ-025 entry status: pending -> done. No other field needed correction -- description/acceptance_criteria already matched the shipped mechanism exactly.
2. Appended one 'done' event to docs/status/requirement_status.yaml (append-only; read the full file first (240 lines) before appending; `git diff --numstat` confirmed 5 insertions / 0 deletions on this file before committing).
3. Checked README.md (grep for notification/ledger/scheduler/rate-limit/apps-bot terms) -- still contains no bot-flow-specific content beyond the one generic apps/bot description line from REQ-009's doc-update step, so no README update was made -- same checked-then-skipped pattern as every prior bot requirement (REQ-010 through REQ-024).
4. Checked docs/ for an existing bot-command-reference doc (find for *command*, excluding node_modules) -- none exists anywhere in the repo, consistent with the established pattern noted at REQ-018 through REQ-024's doc-update steps, so none was created here.
5. No 'Phase complete' marker added -- REQ-025 is the FIRST of Phase 5's three requirements (REQ-026 T-24h/T-3h reminder jobs, REQ-027 cancellation notification remain).
